title: Privacy Policy
body:
Privacy Policy

This website collects only the information you voluntarily provide through the contact form (name, email, message) and anonymous usage statistics. Your data is never sold or shared with third parties.

Cookies

A session cookie is used only when you sign in. Theme preference is stored in your browser's local storage.

Contact

Questions? Use the contact form on the home page.

title: Help & Support
body:
Help & Support

Need help with a download, a project inquiry or a collaboration? Send a message through the contact form and you will get a reply within 48 hours.
